judgment_policy.deduplication: first retrieved chunk establishes each paper's rank
judgment_policy.limitation: Precision assumes the reviewed silver relevance set is complete; interpret it cautiously if relevance pooling is incomplete.
judgment_policy.unjudged_policy: unjudged retrieved papers count as non-relevant

metric_definitions.hit_at_k: For answerable queries, 1 when at least one judged relevant paper occurs in the first k unique papers; otherwise 0.
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_10: For answerable queries with explicit graded judgments, DCG@10 using gain 2^grade-1 divided by the ideal DCG@10.
metric_definitions.precision_at_k: For answerable queries, |unique relevant papers in the first k unique papers| / k; unjudged papers are treated as non-relevant.
metric_definitions.reciprocal_rank: For answerable queries, reciprocal of the rank of the first judged relevant unique paper; 0 when none is retrieved.
metric_definitions.set_recall_at_k: For answerable queries, |unique relevant papers in the first k unique papers| / |all judged relevant papers|.
metric_definitions.unanswerable_abstention: For a judged-unanswerable query, 1 only when the retriever returns no unique paper; otherwise 0.
metric_definitions.unanswerable_false_positive_at_k: For a judged-unanswerable query, 1 when any paper is returned in the first k unique papers; otherwise 0.
